# Container images the object-store integration tests pull via testcontainers.
# CI caches these (keyed on this file's contents) and `docker load`s them so a
# cache hit never pulls from Docker Hub. Keep in sync with the tags the tests
# actually request, or a stale entry just causes a one-time miss (testcontainers
# pulls the real tag itself):
#   - MinIO: testcontainers-modules `MinIO` default tag (bump with that crate)
#   - fake-gcs-server: the tag in datastore-pivotlake/src/test_support.rs. This is
#     the fork `object_store` tests its own GCS client against; the upstream
#     image serves no XML API, which is what Delta Kernel's client speaks.
#   - iceberg-rest-fixture: the tag in datastore-iceberg/tests/rest_catalog.rs,
#     the REST catalog the Iceberg datastore's tests write to and read from.
#   - spark: the tag in datastore-iceberg/tests/rest_catalog.rs, the Spark that
#     writes to the catalog what the iceberg crate's writer cannot (a delete).
#     It fetches the Iceberg runtime from Maven into a Docker volume of its
#     own, kept between runs.
minio/minio:RELEASE.2025-02-28T09-55-16Z
tustvold/fake-gcs-server:latest
apache/iceberg-rest-fixture:1.9.1
apache/spark:3.5.9
